body.statement: If the supplied \(\mathcal K\) is a vertex cover of \(C_G\), then all \(F_{\ell,A}(z)\) with \(|A|\le2\) are computable exactly in \(Lk!3^k\operatorname{poly}(n,b,\lambda)\) bit operations, and every intermediate rational has bit length \(2^{O(k\log(k+1))}\operatorname{poly}(n,b,\lambda)\).
body.justification: This complete special case checks the core chamber integration and bit model before heterogeneous tree branching is introduced.
body.gap: Static vertex-cover dynamic programs do not assign weighted greedy-order probability, while the parent proposal did not prove this feedback-core chamber formula.
body.consumer: Experiments whose cycles are concentrated on a small hub set obtain an immediate exact AWRI selection routine.
